$Comment: Percent chance a block in the Light block family is not used up when placed, in whole percent points, added to BuildThrift for such a block (only on blocks the Thrift family lets through, never ore, metal, gems or furniture) and held at BuildThriftMax by ziggfreed-common's thrift step. Any item's StatModifiers raise it like any stat, and so does an effect's RawStatModifiers. Base 0; Min is a generous negative so a subtractive modifier never clamps.
